# Synthetic fixtures

Everything here is invented. Files in this folder are exempt from the
`.gitignore` rules for CSV and PDF files, so **never place a real or partly
redacted document here** without review.

`volume_probes/` holds invented `diskutil info -plist` and `hdiutil info -plist`
answers, with the keys they report on macOS Golden Gate 27.2 and made-up values
(M5.2).
